**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One natural workflow series, not sixteen separate cases. The source describes reference-based character GIFs (idle, swim, run, jump, kart, stance and punch) for a 96-second music video. Only the published swimming contact sheet is archived. The completed music video combines model-generated characters and some backgrounds with Claude Code/Python compositing, backgrounds, lyrics and retro effects; it is not native model video output. Exact prompts, reference input and native GIF files were not published on the inspected article.
